description: Tick or untick shots and checklist items. Each op: itemKey "shot:<shotId>" or "check:<itemId>" from shoot_plan_get, basePlanVersion = the plan's version, a new random UUID v4 as opId, state "complete" or "incomplete". Retry-safe: resending the same opId does nothing twice. An op made against an older basePlanVersion still applies when that item is unchanged in the current version; otherwise its result is item_changed_in_current_version and nothing changes. Ticking records that the person checked the shot, not its technical quality. Use the full taskId from shoot_plan_list (not planId). A unique eight-character task prefix or orderReference also works. Connections see only their own live or owner-test plans.
name: shoot_plan_progress_sync
title: Tick off shots
